support_gate.known_nonempty_definition: geometry_valid and original attribute_valid, any foreground, scale[0]==0 and scale simplex valid; no replacement of unknown or padding filtering
support_gate.failure_action: STOP this candidate formal runs; do not resample bank, change target/loss/window/seed or threshold to obtain pass
support_gate.passing_action: May start only prospectively frozen matched2000 candidate blocks after own actual model/data/runtime QA; no evidence of information or efficacy claimed
support_gate.diagnostic_permutation: Per case known-nonempty slots sorted, shift=max(1,floor(n/2)); preserve own predicted q and re-pair full four-component conditional r; other patches unchanged

initial_other_predicted_r_components: not recorded; null; p0..p4 retained, only recorded conditional fine is reported
GT_availability: Valid empty: GT_q1, GT_r null; known nonempty: GT_q0, original four FP32 histogram masses; unknown: GT_q/r null
prediction_stage_scope: INITIAL_SHARED old warmstart classifier; PRIMARY_Dlearn and SECONDARY_Dlearn final D classifier only; no final C bank inference
